title: Movable AI Assistant + Update Preview
features: The AI assistant is now movable — drag its button (or the chat window's header) anywhere on screen, and it remembers where you put it
Before a software update installs, you'll now see exactly what's new and can choose to update or cancel — clicking Update downloads and installs it in one step
fixes: The chat button and window always stay fully on screen, even after resizing the window

title: Sermon Media on Cloud Storage + Private Receipts
features: Sermon audio and video now upload to dedicated cloud storage with plenty of room for large recordings, and play back from a fast CDN — on the cloud and cached offline on the desktop
Attach a receipt (photo or PDF) directly to an expenditure. Receipts are stored privately and can only be viewed by finance roles (finance officer, pastor/admin, super admin) — no more pasting links
fixes: Receipt uploads are validated up front (type and size) so a receipt can never silently fail to sync
Uploading a receipt on the desktop while offline stages it locally and moves it to private storage on the next sync

title: Embed Sermon Videos & Sync Your Church Logo
features: Add a sermon by pasting a YouTube, Vimeo or Facebook video link — it plays right on the sermon card, no upload needed. Uploading a file still works too.
Your church logo and settings now sync across every device and the cloud — set the logo once and it shows up everywhere
fixes: Adding sermon videos by link respects the same permissions as uploads — only enabled users in enabled departments can post media

title: Photos, Logos & Sermon Media Everywhere
features: Uploaded files — church logo, sermon audio/video, photos and documents — now sync between the cloud and your devices, and are cached locally so they still open when you're offline
Large sermon recordings upload directly and reliably — no more size wall
fixes: A file uploaded on the desktop now becomes available in the cloud and on your other devices once it syncs (previously it stayed on that one computer)
Uploads are now authenticated and restricted to media/document types

title: Team Members, Invites & Roles
features: New 'Users & Roles' admin page — invite teammates by email or create their login directly, and assign roles (Pastor, Finance Officer, Department Head, Data Entry) yourself
Give a member their own app login straight from their profile — 'Invite / Create login' with a role, which links the member to their account
The desktop app now supports multiple staff accounts on one device, each with their own role and sign-in (single-user installs still open straight to the dashboard)
fixes: Setup no longer asks new churches to pick a role — whoever creates the church is its administrator, and roles are assigned by admins afterwards
Hardened account security: roles can only be changed by administrators, and closed a loophole that could have exposed one church's data to another

title: Cloud Sync Reliability
fixes: Cloud sync now keeps a durable, unbounded record of any records that couldn't sync on the first attempt and keeps retrying them until they succeed — across app restarts and large batches — so a record is never silently left behind

title: Cloud Sync & a New Status Bar
features: Automatic background cloud sync — the standalone app now keeps your members, giving, events and records in step with the cloud, syncing silently when you're online (and picking up right where it left off after being offline)
New status bar at the bottom of the desktop app showing your online status, cloud-sync status and when it last synced, and software-update progress
Software updates now download and install right from the status bar instead of a pop-up window
fixes: This first version of sync merges records (last edit wins) and does not remove deleted records or transfer uploaded files/photos yet — those will come in a later update

title: Sign in to the Desktop App with Your Cloud Account
features: The standalone app now activates with your existing ChurchConnect account — sign in once with the same email and password (internet needed only for this one-time step)
After activation the app opens straight to your dashboard and works fully offline; it never asks you to sign in again on that device
fixes: Hardened the desktop's local server — removed cross-origin access and added loopback host checks so no website can reach it

title: Richer Member Profiles — Family, Address History & Giving
features: Click any member's name to open a full profile with their contact, address, family and giving at a glance
Address history — when a member's address changes it is kept for reference, not overwritten

Family tree — link a member's spouse, children and parents; linking a registered member reflects on their profile too, and you can jump between family members. Unregistered relatives are stored with their contact details
Per-member Total Tithe and Total Welfare, each expandable to a full history you can download or print as a PDF statement
New 'Welfare' giving type for recording member welfare contributions
fixes: Financial and statement PDFs now render correctly for the cedi (GHS) and naira (NGN) currency symbols

title: Monthly Finance Dashboard & Sleeker Updates
features: Dashboard finance cards are now monthly — Tithes, Offerings, Other Inflow and Approved Expenses each show the selected month with a week-by-week breakdown
Month navigator on the dashboard to view any month (January–December) and download that month's PDF report on the spot
New 'Other Inflow' / 'Others' giving bucket separates special offerings, thanksgiving, building fund and other income from regular offerings
Financial Reports page now switches month/year instantly, adds an 'Others' total, and is centered
fixes: Finance figures now use the church's configured currency instead of always showing the euro sign
Monthly totals load completely for any month regardless of how much giving history the church has
Cleaned up the financial-report PDF layout so sections no longer overlap
Desktop updates are now non-blocking: the update downloads in the background with a progress bar and applies when you click 'Update', instead of a pop-up that blocked the whole app

title: Critical Desktop Crash Fix
fixes: Fixed app crash on startup in the desktop (offline) version — billing feature check was incorrectly calling a Clerk API that is not available in offline mode

title: Brand Theme Colors & Member Join Flow
features: Church theme color system — set Primary, Secondary, and Accent colors in Church Settings to match your brand identity
Auto-extract colors from your uploaded church logo with a single click using canvas color analysis
Logo watermark — your church logo now appears as a subtle background watermark across all pages
Member sign-up flow — members can sign up independently and request to join a church by entering its URL slug
Admin approval for member join requests — church admins review and approve/reject new member requests from the Access Requests page
Clickable church name in sidebar links to Church Settings (super admin only)
Clickable admin name in sidebar links to User Profile page
fixes: Fixed infinite login loop when Clerk redirected to /login/tasks/choose-organization
Fixed registration page appearing as two separate screens — now a single combined page
Fixed settings save endpoint missing in the offline (desktop) version
Fixed profile link in desktop app sidebar causing a blank 'Page Not Found' screen
Fixed What's New update modal not appearing in the desktop (offline) version

title: Attendance Analytics & Access Requests
features: Attendance analytics page with visual trends and inactive member alerts
Access requests admin page with approve, reject, and revoke controls
Department color accent shown in sidebar for department-scoped roles
AI assistant improvements with finance and pastoral care context
fixes: Fixed token handling in Electron (offline) mode for access request approvals
Improved financial reports page with better chart rendering

title: Small Groups & Pastoral Care
features: Small groups management — create and manage Bible study, prayer, and outreach groups
Pastoral care module — log prayer requests, visitations, and counseling sessions privately
Volunteer tracking with event assignment, role, and check-in status
Announcements with audience targeting by department and priority
fixes: Fixed department head not seeing their assigned features
Fixed giving records not filtering by date range correctly

title: Departments & Role-Based Access
features: Department dashboards with custom feature sets per department
Role-based access control — super admin, pastor admin, finance officer, department head, data entry staff, member
Department heads can manage their own teams and events independently
Properties and assets inventory with condition and assignment tracking
fixes: Fixed member search not matching partial names
Fixed currency symbol not updating in reports after settings change

title: Initial Release
features: Member management with full profiles, milestones, photos, and membership status
Giving and tithe tracking with payment method categorization
Expenditure tracking with approval workflow
Attendance recording by event or service
Event calendar with department-aware scheduling
Sermon archive with audio/video links, scripture references, and tags
Financial reports — giving summaries, expense breakdowns, and trends
Desktop (offline) version for Windows — no internet required
Web version with real-time multi-user collaboration
Built-in AI assistant for pastoral insights and communications
